items.title_en: Civic Hygiene – avoid building technologies that could be used by a police state (2013)
items.title_zh: 公民卫生学——避免打造会被警察国家利用的技术（2013）
items.summary_en: This 2013 post argues for civic hygiene: designing technology with safeguards to prevent misuse by authoritarian regimes. It advocates privacy-by-design, auditability, and user control to guard against surveillance overreach.
items.summary_zh: 2013 年的文章强调‘公民卫生学’，提出在设计技术时要防范被警察专制政权滥用，倡导隐私设计、可审计性和用户控制等原则，以防止监控滥用。

items.title_en: Opus 5.0 drives incoherence into the stratosphere
items.title_zh: Opus 5.0 将不连贯性推向高空
items.summary_en: Claude's Opus 5.0 update appears to substantially worsen output coherence, introducing more hallucinations and untrustworthy responses.
items.summary_zh: Opus 5.0 更新在输出连贯性方面表现不佳，造成更高的错觉与不可信的回答。此帖强调新版本的可靠性问题及对生产场景的影响，呼吁更谨慎的测试与评估。

items.title_en: Remote workers report the highest well-being in study of 7,700 employees
items.title_zh: 远程工作者在7700名员工研究中报告最高幸福感
items.summary_en: A new study surveying 7,700 employees finds remote workers report the highest well-being, with autonomy, flexibility, and better work-life balance as likely drivers. The finding adds to a growing narrative that remote options can boost retention and morale, though outcomes depend on managerial support and monitoring. This has implications for workplace policy and hybrid strategies.
items.summary_zh: 在对7700名员工的调查中，远程工作人员报告了最高的幸福感，原因可能是更高的自主性、灵活性和工作与生活平衡。此发现为远程工作有益员工幸福感的论调再添证据，但成效取决于管理支持与监督。对企业的人力资源政策和混合工作策略具有重要启示。

items.title_en: OpenRouter Is Joining Stripe
items.title_zh: OpenRouter 加入 Stripe
items.summary_en: OpenRouter is partnering with Stripe to embed Stripe's payments rails into its platform. The collaboration broadens OpenRouter's reach for developers and merchants and signals Stripe's appetite for fintech partnerships beyond its own ecosystem. For practitioners, this could translate into easier payments integration, improved compliance tooling, and a more cohesive developer experience.
items.summary_zh: OpenRouter 宣布加入 Stripe，嵌入 Stripe 的支付能力到其平台。此举扩大了 OpenRouter 的覆盖范围，也体现 Stripe 在 fintech 生态之外寻求合作的策略。对开发者来说，意味着更便捷的支付集成、合规工具以及更一致的开发者体验。

items.title_en: Moderna reports first positive Phase 3 for mRNA neoantigen therapy in melanoma
items.title_zh: Moderna 与 Merck 联合推进的 mRNA 癌症疫苗在黑色素瘤三期试验取得积极结果
items.summary_en: A late-stage trial of Moderna and Merck's mRNA neoantigen cancer vaccine shows positive results in melanoma. If validated, this approach could broaden immunotherapy options and demonstrate the viability of personalized cancer vaccines using mRNA, potentially reshaping oncology treatment and investment priorities.
items.summary_zh: Moderna 与 Merck 联合开发的 mRNA 新抗原癌症疫苗在黑色素瘤三期研究中显示积极结果。若后续数据继续支持疗效，这种个性化疫苗有望扩大免疫治疗选择，推动肿瘤领域对 mRNA 疫苗的应用与投资方向。

items.title_en: Devices with GrapheneOS support should be available in 2027
items.title_zh: GrapheneOS 支持设备预计 2027 年可用
items.summary_en: GrapheneOS is aiming to have devices officially supported by 2027, broadening access to a privacy-focused Android ROM. The plan hinges on hardware partnerships and licensing, signaling a push to bring hardened OS to consumer devices. For privacy-conscious users and enterprise deployments, this could translate to more secure smartphones with community-backed updates.
items.summary_zh: GrapheneOS 预计到 2027 年将有设备获得官方支持，推动隐私优先的 Android ROM 面向消费者发布。成功实现需依赖硬件合作与授权，标志着在友好设备上提供更安全系统的努力。对注重隐私的用户和企业部署而言，意味更安全的智能手机和社区驱动的更新。

items.title_en: A joke domain purchase turned in geopolitical warfare
items.title_zh: 一个玩笑域名购买引发的地缘政治冲突
items.summary_en: A whimsical domain-name purchase spirals into geopolitical warfare, illustrating how digital assets can become leverage in information and power struggles. The tale underscores the political fragility and strategic significance of internet infrastructure and branding in a global context.
items.summary_zh: 一个玩笑性质的域名购买竟演变成地缘政治对抗，说明数字资产可以成为信息与权力博弈中的筹码。此事凸显网络基础设施与品牌在全球格局中的政治敏感性与战略意义。

items.title_en: New Casio F-B100W – Upgrade to the iconic F-91W after 40 years
items.title_zh: Casio F-B100W：40 年后升级经典 F-91W
items.summary_en: Casio unveils the F-B100W, a contemporary refresh of the iconic F-91W design after four decades. The watch pairs retro aesthetics with modern reliability and new features, appealing to fans of classic digital watches.
items.summary_zh: Casio 推出 F-B100W，作为经典 F-91W 的四十年续作。新款在保留复古外观的同时，融入现代可靠性与新功能，吸引喜爱经典数字表的用户。

items.title_en: OpenLogi
items.title_zh: OpenLogi：开放物流
items.summary_en: OpenLogi is an initiative focused on open logistics.
items.summary_zh: OpenLogi 是一个专注于开放物流的倡议。

items.title_en: Geolocating a random island using geometry and CUDA programming
items.title_zh: 用几何与 CUDA 编程定位随机岛屿的地理位置
items.summary_en: An OSINT project demonstrates geolocating a randomly generated island using geometric methods and CUDA acceleration. The work shows how high-performance GPU computations can speed up geospatial reasoning and large-scale location inference tasks, with implications for both research and privacy/surveillance discussions.
items.summary_zh: 一个 OSINT 项目演示了如何利用几何方法并借助 CUDA 加速，对一个随机生成的岛屿进行地理定位。该工作展示了高性能 GPU 运算在地理空间推断中的潜力，并对科研与隐私/监控议题带来影响。

items.title_en: PostgreSQL for Everything
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 的万能应用
items.summary_en: PostgreSQL has evolved into a universal data platform, powering everything from traditional OLTP workloads to analytics and beyond thanks to its extensions and JSON support. The post argues for broad adoption and showcases how SQL, JSON, GIS, and procedural languages together enable a wide range of use cases that previously required specialized systems. This trend matters for startups and enterprises rethinking their data stack.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 已发展为通用数据平台，凭借扩展生态、JSON 支持等能力支撑从事务处理到分析等多样化场景。文章强调广泛采用，并展示 SQL、JSON、GIS 和存储过程等特性如何让 PostgreSQL 应对此前需要专用系统的场景。这一趋势对初创和企业在重塑数据栈时具有重要意义。

items.title_en: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: Ornith-1.5：从自我搭建到自我提升
items.summary_en: Ornith-1.5 advances autonomous agent capabilities, shifting from self-scaffolding to self-improvement. The update likely introduces mechanisms for agents to autonomously refine their prompts, policies, or code with less human input, pushing toward more self-managed AI workflows. This accelerates experimentation but raises safety and reliability concerns around unchecked agent self-modification.
items.summary_zh: Ornith-1.5 在自主代理能力上进一步从自我搭建转向自我提升，加入能在较少人为干预下自我改进的机制。更新使代理能够自行优化提示、策略甚至代码，从而加快实验迭代，但也带来安全与可靠性方面的担忧。

items.title_en: Air Theremin – a browser theremin you play by waving at your webcam
items.title_zh: Air Theremin：通过摄像头在浏览器中挥手演奏的 Theremin
items.summary_en: Air Theremin is a browser-based instrument controlled by waving at your webcam. It demonstrates how computer vision, WebAudio, and creative UI can deliver interactive music experiences directly in the browser.
items.summary_zh: Air Theremin 是一款通过摄像头挥手来控制的浏览器乐器。它展示了计算机视觉、WebAudio 与创新界面在浏览器中实现互动音乐体验的潜力。

items.title_en: The Amazon tax
items.title_zh: 亚马逊税
items.summary_en: A provocative take on an 'Amazon tax' arguing that targeting a single platform is poor digital-economy policy. It weighs effects on sellers, competition, and innovation, and suggests broader tax ideas rather than platform-specific levies.
items.summary_zh: 对所谓的“亚马逊税”提出尖锐质疑，认为单独针对一个平台不是数字经济的良策。文章分析对卖家、竞争和创新的影响，并倡导更全面的税制设计，避免扭曲市场激励。

items.title_en: Extensible Software in the Age of LLMs
items.title_zh: AI 时代的可扩展软件
items.summary_en: As LLMs recast software, extensible architectures—plugins, adapters, and safe execution sandboxes—become essential. The post outlines how to design software that can be extended by external tools while maintaining security, versioning, and governance. It argues that composable systems will drive productivity but require careful boundaries around data flow and trust.
items.summary_zh: 在大型语言模型时代，软件的可扩展性（通过插件、适配器和安全执行沙箱等）变得必不可少。文章探讨如何设计能被外部工具扩展的系统，同时确保安全、版本控制与治理。作者认为组件化、可组合的架构将提升生产力，但需对数据流与信任设定清晰边界。

items.title_en: How Kubernetes Probes Work
items.title_zh: Kubernetes 探针工作原理
items.summary_en: Kubernetes probes determine whether containers are ready or healthy, influencing pod lifecycle and rollout behavior. Probes like liveness, readiness, and startup probes help detect failures and avoid traffic routing to unhealthy pods, but misconfig can cause unnecessary restarts or slow deployments. The piece likely explains practical tuning tips and pitfalls.
items.summary_zh: Kubernetes 探针用来判断容器是否就绪或健康，直接影响 Pod 的生命周期和滚动更新策略。通过存活、就绪和启动探针，系统可以在发现故障时隔离或重新调度，但配置不当会导致不必要的重启或部署变慢。本文提供了实际的调优要点与常见坑。

items.title_en: Cop Explains Why He Used License Plate Reader to Stalk Woman
items.title_zh: 警察使用车牌识别系统追踪女性的解释
items.summary_en: A police officer defends using a license-plate reader to track a woman's movements, drawing scrutiny over surveillance overreach and civil liberties.
items.summary_zh: 一名警官为使用车牌识别系统追踪一名女性辩解，引发对监控滥用与公民自由的质疑。文章强调对自动化监控的滥用风险、以及制定清晰政策与问责机制的重要性。

items.title_en: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in the Wild Is Not Always Faithful
items.title_zh: 野外的链式推理并不总是可信
items.summary_en: New findings show that chain-of-thought explanations produced by language models in real-world tasks can be unreliable or misleading. The study argues that intermediate reasoning traces do not always reflect actual reasoning paths and can be manipulated by prompt design. This challenges the reliability of using CoT as a transparency tool and suggests alternative evaluation approaches.
items.summary_zh: 研究发现，现实任务中语言模型输出的链式推理并不总是可信，中间的推理迹象并不能可靠地代表实际思考路径，且可能被提示设计所误导。这对把链式推理当作透明度工具的做法提出质疑，提示需要更可靠的评估方法。

items.title_en: The Mojo language (by Modular, now Qualcomm) is now open-source
items.title_zh: Mojo 语言现已开源（Modular/Qualcomm）
items.summary_en: Mojo, the high-performance language from Modular (now under Qualcomm), is now open source. This move could accelerate adoption by enabling community-driven tooling, expanding the ecosystem, and bringing Python-like ergonomics together with nearer-native speed for AI workloads.
items.summary_zh: Modular（现为 Qualcomm）推出的高性能编程语言 Mojo 已开源。此举有望通过社区驱动的工具链、生态扩展与接近本地速度的 AI 工作负载体验，推动语言的采用与生态繁荣。

items.title_en: Cerebras CS-4
items.title_zh: Cerebras CS-4 新一代AI加速器
items.summary_en: Cerebras unveiled CS-4, the next-generation wafer-scale AI accelerator aimed at speeding large-model training and inference. It emphasizes higher memory bandwidth and efficiency to help scale models beyond what conventional accelerators handle, signaling where enterprise AI compute is headed.
items.summary_zh: Cerebras 发布 CS-4，这款新一代晶圆级AI加速器旨在提升大模型的训练与推理性能。它强调更高的内存带宽和能效，试图解决传统加速器难以扩展的算力瓶颈，预示着企业级AI算力的发展方向。

items.title_en: Launch HN: OneCLI (YC S26) – OSS sandboxed agent harness for teams
items.title_zh: OneCLI 开源沙箱代理框架面向团队
items.summary_en: OneCLI is an open-source sandboxed agent harness designed for teams to orchestrate and govern multiple AI agents safely. It provides isolation, audit logs, and governance features to reduce risk when using autonomous agents in collaborative workflows. This launch signals growing demand for team-friendly, auditable AI tooling in early-stage ecosystems like YC S26.
items.summary_zh: OneCLI 是一个面向团队的开源沙箱代理框架，用于安全地编排多代理。它提供隔离、审计日志和治理等功能，降低在协作工作流中使用自主代理的风险。此次发布反映了团队友好、可审计的 AI 工具在初创生态中的需求增长。

items.title_en: Sticky wage norms and the real wage cost of unexpected inflation
items.title_zh: 粘性工资规范与意外通胀的实际工资成本
items.summary_en: An economics working paper examines how wage rigidity and sticky norms translate into bite when inflation surprises. The findings imply workers may suffer more real income losses than headline inflation suggests, and policy may need to address wage-setting frictions.
items.summary_zh: 一篇经济学工作论文分析了工资僵化与粘性规范如何在通胀意外时放大实际工资成本。研究表明，实际收入损失可能比名义通胀更严重，对工资设定摩擦的政策干预也许是必要的。

items.title_en: Beware Management Consultants
items.title_zh: 警惕管理咨询顾问
items.summary_en: External management consultants are often sold as a cure-all, but the article warns their initiatives can be shallow and unsustainable. It advocates building internal capability and applying critical judgment to avoid hollow transformations.
items.summary_zh: 外部管理咨询顾问常被包装为万灵药，但文章警告他们的方案可能肤浅且难以持续。强调建立内部能力并以批判性判断来避免空洞的转型。

items.title_en: Scientists stunned by children's lung recovery in ultra low emission zone
items.title_zh: 超低排放区使儿童肺部康复，科学家感到震惊
items.summary_en: New data shows children living near ultra-low emission zones show measurable improvements in lung function, surprising researchers. The findings support policies that curb pollution in urban areas and underscore how quickly air quality impacts child health.
items.summary_zh: 研究发现居住在超低排放区的儿童肺功能有明显改善，令研究人员感到惊讶。结果支持在城市地区加强空气污染治理的政策，并突出空气质量对儿童健康的快速影响。

items.title_en: Meta's blockbuster trial draws parallels to big tobacco
items.title_zh: Meta 的重磅诉讼被拿来与大烟草案比较
items.summary_en: Regulators compare Meta's high-profile trial to decades-long tobacco litigation, highlighting how regulatory strategies, settlement dynamics, and public health framing influence tech accountability. If precedent solidifies, the case could reshape platform liability and data practices.
items.summary_zh: 监管者将 Meta 的这场重磅诉讼类比于长期的烟草案，强调监管策略、和解动态以及公共健康话语对科技问责的影响。若判例确立，案件可能重新定义平台责任与数据实践。

items.title_en: Show HN: Frugal Tokens – explore costs and usage across coding agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：Frugal Tokens – 探索编码代理的成本与使用
items.summary_en: Frugal Tokens is an interactive demo that reveals token costs and usage patterns across coding agents. It helps developers budget AI-assisted coding workloads, compare cost-performance, and optimize prompts and calls to reduce spend.
items.summary_zh: Frugal Tokens 是一个展示不同编码代理工具在使用过程中产生的 token 成本与用量的交互式演示。它帮助开发者对 AI 助力的编码 workloads 进行预算、对比性评估与成本优化，从而降低支出。

items.title_en: Mathematics in the Age of AI
items.title_zh: AI 时代的数学
items.summary_en: ArXiv paper discusses how AI is transforming mathematical practice, from automated proof assistance to heuristic discovery. It surveys the evolving role of AI in research workflows, collaboration, and education, and argues for new benchmarks and reproducibility practices.
items.summary_zh: 这篇 ArXiv 论文探讨 AI 如何改变数学研究的实践，例如自动化证明援助、启发式发现等。分析 AI 在研究工作流、协作和教育中的新角色，并提出需要新的基准与可重复性机制。

items.title_en: A 3D fruit fly on macOS desktop powered by the real FlyWire connectome
items.title_zh: 基于真实 FlyWire 连接组的 macOS 桌面 3D 果蝇可视化
items.summary_en: A desktop app renders a real FlyWire connectome-based 3D fruit fly on macOS, illustrating the feasibility of immersive neuroscience data visualization and educational demos on a consumer PC.
items.summary_zh: 一个桌面应用在 macOS 上呈现基于真实 FlyWire 连接组的三维果蝇，可视化神经科学数据与教育演示在普通个人电脑上的可行性。

items.title_en: How does IKEA come up with names for its products?
items.title_zh: IKEA 产品名是怎么起的？
items.summary_en: IKEA uses a structured naming system with Swedish origins and product-type cues to help scale branding across markets. The approach aids memorability and organization as the catalog grows.
items.summary_zh: IKEA 对产品名采用结构化命名体系，结合瑞典语词汇与产品类型暗示，方便全球市场的品牌统一与记忆度提升，随/catalog 的扩张而更显组织性。

items.title_en: And then the men with guns tell you to do it anyway
items.title_zh: 然后拿枪的人仍要你照做
items.summary_en: A provocative piece about compliance under coercion and the ethical boundaries of following orders when authorities threaten you, with lessons for technologists and policy-makers.
items.summary_zh: 一篇发人深省的文章，讨论在威胁下的服从与道德边界，给技术人员与政策制定者的启示。

items.title_en: Palomar: A registry of Lean verified mathematics
items.title_zh: Palomar：Lean 验证数学的注册库
items.summary_en: Palomar is a registry that catalogs mathematics proven in Lean, enabling researchers to reference machine-checked results with confidence. It helps track formalized theorems across libraries and fosters collaboration between mathematicians and proof assistants.
items.summary_zh: Palomar 是一个收录 Lean 验证数学定理的注册库，便于研究者对机器可验证的结果进行可信引用。它帮助在各个库之间跟踪形式化定理，促进数学家与证明助手的协作。

items.title_en: Solo – a .so loader for static Linux binaries
items.title_zh: Solo：用于静态 Linux 二进制的 .so 加载器
items.summary_en: Solo provides a loader that enables static Linux binaries to load shared libraries at runtime, effectively giving them some dynamic behavior without re-linking. This can simplify porting and deployment of statically built apps, but raises questions about security and compatibility.
items.summary_zh: Solo 提供一个加载器，使静态 Linux 二进制在运行时加载共享库，从而在不重新链接的情况下获得动态行为。便于静态构建应用的移植与部署，但也带来安全与兼容性方面的挑战。

items.title_en: Turbovec – Google's TurboQuant for vector search in Rust
items.title_zh: Turbovec—谷歌在 Rust 的向量搜索加速器（TurboQuant）
items.summary_en: Turbovec is Google's Rust-based tool for fast vector similarity search, enabling efficient user embeddings and approximate nearest-neighbor queries. It showcases how Rust can power high-throughput NN workloads with a compact API.
items.summary_zh: Turbovec 是谷歌基于 Rust 的向量相似性搜索工具，能够高效处理嵌入向量并实现近似最近邻查询。展示了 Rust 在高吞吐量向量工作负载中的潜力与简洁 API。

items.title_en: Apple announces changes for apps in the European Union
items.title_zh: 苹果宣布欧盟应用的新规
items.summary_en: Apple outlines changes to app practices in the EU, likely around app store rules, privacy, data handling, or sideloading restrictions. The move reflects regulatory tightening in Europe and how app developers must adapt to evolving compliance and monetization rules.
items.summary_zh: 苹果公布在欧盟的应用规则调整，涉及应用商店、隐私与数据处理等方面的合规要求。此举回应欧洲日益严格的监管环境，敦促开发者调整合规与商业模式。

items.title_en: AI usage patterns in software teams
items.title_zh: 软件团队的 AI 使用模式
items.summary_en: Survey data reveals how software teams adopt and integrate AI tools into daily workflows, highlighting common patterns, bottlenecks, and governance gaps. The findings help teams optimize tooling choices, collaboration, and risk management as AI becomes a routine part of development.
items.summary_zh: 调查显示软件团队在日常工作中采用AI工具的常见模式、瓶颈与治理缺口。结果可帮助团队在工具选择、协作和风险管理等方面做出更明智的决策，让AI成为开发日常的一部分。

items.title_en: λλ: A Programming Language for Silicon Photonics
items.title_zh: λλ：一门用于硅光子学的编程语言
items.summary_en: λλ is a programming language designed for silicon photonics, enabling high-level control of photonic hardware. The project explores software abstractions for specialized hardware, hinting at a future where optical computing workflows are more accessible to developers.
items.summary_zh: λλ 是一门面向硅光子学的编程语言，旨在为光子硬件提供更高层次的编程抽象。该项目探索针对专用硬件的软硬件协同，预示着未来光子计算工作流可能更加易于开发者使用。

items.title_en: Best Buy 'Repaired' a 64GB Laptop by Making It 32GB
items.title_zh: Best Buy 用 32GB 取代 64GB 笔记本的维修
items.summary_en: Customer reports Best Buy returned a 64GB laptop showing 32GB capacity after repair, implying storage was reduced or misconfigured. This underscores QA gaps in service workflows and raises consumer rights questions about warranty repairs and accurate hardware specs.
items.summary_zh: 有顾客曝料 Best Buy 维修后一台 64GB 笔记本显示只有 32GB 容量，暗示存储被缩减或配置错误。这凸显服务流程中的质控漏洞，并引发对保修维修和硬件规格准确性的关注。

items.title_en: Show HN: Automatically detect and patch walking-dead states in Sierra games
items.title_zh: Show HN：自动检测并修补 Sierra 时代游戏中的无效状态
items.summary_en: An open-source project that scans Sierra-era adventure games to identify dead-end or unwinnable states and automatically patches them. The patcher improves playability and preserves classic gameplay without manual modding.
items.summary_zh: 一个开源项目，能够自动扫描 Sierra 风格的冒险游戏，识别无进展的状态并进行补丁以解决问题。该工具提升了可玩性，保持经典游戏的体验，无需手动修改。

items.title_en: Claude writing a macOS driver for my obscure HP printer built only for Windows
items.title_zh: Claude 为我那台仅 Windows 构建的冷门 HP 打印机写 macOS 驱动
items.summary_en: An anecdote about an AI assistant drafting a macOS driver for a niche Windows-only HP printer, illustrating AI-assisted software maintenance and the friction of cross-platform hardware.
items.summary_zh: AI 助手为一台仅在 Windows 平台上有驱动的冷门 HP 打印机编写 macOS 驱动，体现跨平台维护与 AI 辅助开发的现实挑战。

items.title_en: Memory prices climb 500% in 12 months
items.title_zh: 内存价格在一年内上涨 500%
items.summary_en: Memory prices surged 500% year over year, with high-end DDR5 kits reaching thousands of dollars per kit; supply-chain pressures and demand for AI workloads drive the spike. The article warns about the impact on builders and data centers, and signals potential normalization after inventory adjustments.
items.summary_zh: 内存价格在一年内暴涨约 500%，高端 DDR5 套件价格甚至达到数千美元。供应链压力和对 AI 工作负载的需求推动价格上涨，文章分析对硬件建设者与数据中心的影响，并暗示库存回稳后可能回落。

items.title_en: Finger: the 1971 social network that never died
items.title_zh: Finger：1971年的社交网络从未消失
items.summary_en: Finger, an early online social networking protocol from 1971, persisted in niche communities and influenced later identity services. The piece traces its lineage from ARPANET roots to modern social computing.
items.summary_zh: 回顾性文章讲述 Finger——1971 年的早期在线社交网络，尽管时间久远却在部分社区依然存在并影响了后来的身份服务。文章梳理了它从 ARPANET 起源到现代社交计算的演变脉络。

items.title_en: Moderna and Merck say mRNA cancer vaccine succeeded in late-stage melanoma trial
items.title_zh: Moderna 与 Merck 联手的 mRNA 癌症疫苗在晚期黑色素瘤试验取得成功
items.summary_en: Moderna and Merck report positive results from a late-stage trial of an mRNA cancer vaccine in melanoma, potentially expanding options for immunotherapy. If validated, this could accelerate the adoption of mRNA vaccines in oncology and influence research funding and regulatory timelines.
items.summary_zh: Moderna 与 Merck 在晚期黑色素瘤的 mRNA 癌症疫苗三期试验中取得积极结果，可能扩展免疫治疗选择。若数据继续稳健，该策略或加速 mRNA 疫苗在肿瘤治疗中的应用，并影响研究资金与监管节奏。

items.title_en: Show HN: Interactive, animated architecture of any HuggingFace models
items.title_zh: Show HN：可交互、动画化展示任意 HuggingFace 模型的架构
items.summary_en: A live, animated visualization tool mapping the structure and components of HuggingFace models. It helps researchers and engineers quickly understand architectures, connections, and data flow, potentially accelerating model analysis and pedagogy.
items.summary_zh: 这个互动动画可视化工具展示 HuggingFace 模型的结构和组成部分，便于研究人员和工程师快速理解架构、连接和数据流，有望提升模型分析与教学效率。

items.title_en: Python Polars Cheatsheet (based on our O'Reilly book)
items.title_zh: 基于 O'Reilly 书的 Python Polars 速查表
items.summary_en: A Python Polars cheatsheet distilled from an O'Reilly book, covering core APIs, lazy evaluation, and common patterns, useful for engineers migrating from pandas to Polars.
items.summary_zh: 基于 O'Reilly 一本书整理的 Python Polars 速查表，涵盖核心 API、惰性计算和常用模式，方便从 Pandas 转向 Polars 的数据工程师快速查阅。

items.title_en: Being ambitious and being a dad
items.title_zh: 野心与父亲身份的平衡
items.summary_en: A personal reflection on balancing ambition with parenting. It argues that meaningful progress can be made by redefining success, setting realistic expectations, and integrating family priorities into career planning.
items.summary_zh: 对平衡野心与为人父母身份的个人反思。文中主张通过重新定义成功、设定现实目标、并将家庭优先级纳入职业规划来实现有意义的进步。

items.title_en: Stop Anthropomorphizing Intermediate Tokens as Reasoning/Thinking Traces
items.title_zh: 停止把中间令牌当作推理/思考痕迹来拟人化
items.summary_en: Editorial argues against treating intermediate tokens from language models as genuine reasoning traces or evidence of thought. It advocates more robust evaluation methods and cautions against drawing conclusions about internal processes from surface outputs.
items.summary_zh: 作者呼吁不要把语言模型的中间 token 当作真实推理迹象或思考过程的证据，应采用更稳健的评估方法，警惕仅凭表层输出推断内部推理。

items.title_en: The Vietnam Binh Chau (Chau Tan) Late Tang Wreck
items.title_zh: 越南滨蕉晚唐沉船（Chau Tan）
items.summary_en: Archaeologists revealed a late Tang Dynasty wreck at Binh Chau in Vietnam, offering new insights into maritime trade routes and artifacts from the era.
items.summary_zh: 考古学家公布了位于越南滨蕉的晚唐沉船发现，为研究当时的海上贸易路线与出土文物提供新线索。

items.title_en: Ask HN: GitHub employees what's going on? Why?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：GitHub 员工到底在发生什么？为何？
items.summary_en: A discussion probing what’s going on inside GitHub and why certain decisions are being made, offering insider and community perspectives on the company’s direction.
items.summary_zh: 讨论探讨 GitHub 内部发生了什么，以及为何作出某些决策，汇集内部与社区对公司走向的看法。

items.title_en: Tiny satellite will use the dark side of the Moon as a shield
items.title_zh: 微小卫星将用月球背面作为屏蔽
items.image_url: https://www.cam.ac.ukCosmoCube CREDIT Surrey Space Technology Ltd.jpg
items.summary_en: A nanosatellite will utilize the Moon's far side to shield its radio observations from radio noise, enabling quieter measurements of the early universe’s whispers. The mission demonstrates how celestial bodies can aid deep-space cosmology experiments.
items.summary_zh: 一个微型卫星将利用月球背面作为屏蔽，以隔离射频噪声，获得更安静的早期宇宙信号测量。此任务展示了天体如何辅助深空宇宙学实验。

items.title_en: What's in a PowerPoint File?
items.title_zh: PowerPoint 文件里到底有什么？
items.summary_en: Deep dive into the PPTX format explains how PowerPoint packs slides, media, and fonts into a ZIP container with XML definitions.
items.summary_zh: 深入讲解 PPTX 文件格式，说明 PowerPoint 如何将幻灯片、媒体和字体打包在一个带有 XML 定义的 ZIP 容器中。文章还讨论开发者在程序化编辑、资源提取与互操作性方面的实际影响。

items.title_en: California's new tire efficiency rules could save drivers $1B a year
items.title_zh: 加州新轮胎能效法规每年可为司机省下10亿美元
items.summary_en: California's tire efficiency rules could save drivers about $1B annually by reducing rolling resistance. The policy underscores ongoing efforts to improve vehicle efficiency and could foreshadow broader adoption.
items.summary_zh: 加州的新轮胎能效规则通过降低滚阻，预计每年可为司机节省约10亿美元。政策凸显持续推动车辆高效化的趋势，也可能为未来更广泛的采用铺路。

items.title_en: Launch HN: machine0 (YC S26) – Persistent CPU and GPU VMs from the CLI
items.title_zh: Launch HN：machine0（YC S26）—CLI 持久化 CPU 与 GPU 虚拟机
items.summary_en: machine0 offers persistent CPU and GPU VMs accessible from the command line, enabling continuous compute without reinitializing sessions. This could streamline dev/test workflows and simplify cost management for on-demand compute.
items.summary_zh: machine0 提供可从命令行访问的持久化 CPU/GPU 虚拟机，支持持续计算而无需重新初始化。对开发测试工作流和按需计算成本管理有潜在帮助。

items.title_en: AI Has Plunged the Book Publishing Industry into Utter Chaos
items.title_zh: AI 已让图书出版业陷入混乱
items.summary_en: AI-generated content, distribution shifts, and pricing pressures are disrupting traditional book publishing, raising questions about rights, quality control, and author compensation. The piece calls for reassessing workflows and industry norms to adapt to the AI era.
items.summary_zh: AI 生成内容、分销变革与定价压力正在打乱传统出版模式，带来版权、内容质量与作者报酬等方面的挑战。文章呼吁重新评估工作流程和行业规范，以在 AI 时代找到新平衡。

items.title_en: Microgpt in pure C hits 10M tps on Apple m5
items.title_zh: 纯 C 实现的 MicroGPT 在苹果 M5 上达到 1000 万 tps
items.summary_en: Pure-C implementation of MicroGPT achieves 10 million tokens per second on Apple M5 hardware, underscoring impressive runtime efficiency and the potential for lightweight AI inference on consumer devices. This demonstrates how language models can be ported to low-level, high-performance stacks, enabling edge AI use cases.
items.summary_zh: 纯 C 实现的 MicroGPT 在苹果 M5 硬件上达到 1,000 万 tokens/秒，凸显低级语言实现下的高效推理能力，点亮边缘 AI 的潜力。此成就展示了将语言模型移植到高性能、低开销的栈上的可行性，便于在本地设备部署。

items.title_en: That Disgraceful, Disreputable, (Wonderful) Form of Punctuation: The Parenthesis
items.title_zh: 那种不讨喜却迷人的标点符号：括号
items.summary_en: An essay exploring the parenthesis, tracing its history, quirks, and role in modern writing. The piece argues that parentheses can be playful, practical, and even indispensable when used with restraint.
items.summary_zh: 一篇文章探讨括号的历史、用法与在现代写作中的作用，指出括号既可顽皮也可实用，恰当使用时甚至不可或缺。

items.title_en: Proposal to prohibit vibe coded projects from being hosted on Sourcehut
items.title_zh: Sourcehut：禁止 vibe 编码风格项目在 Sourcehut 托管
items.summary_en: A governance proposal suggests Sourcehut should prohibit hosting vibe-coded projects, prompting a broader discussion about platform policy, community standards, and project branding. The debate highlights how hosting rules can shape OSS culture and influence what developers can publish.
items.summary_zh: 一项治理提案建议 Sourcehut 禁止托管带有 vibe 编码风格的项目，引发关于平台政策、社区规范与项目品牌的讨论。此议题凸显托管规则如何影响开源社区文化与开发者的发布选择。

items.title_en: Does AI stop children from learning?
items.title_zh: AI 是否会阻碍儿童学习？
items.summary_en: A look at whether AI enhances or hinders children's learning, weighing evidence from cognitive development, classroom use, and long-term skills. The piece presents nuanced conclusions and practical considerations for educators and policymakers.
items.summary_zh: 从认知发展、课堂应用与长期技能三个维度探讨 AI 是否提升或削弱儿童学习。文章给出较为细致的结论，并提出教育者和政策制定者应考虑的实际要点。

items.title_en: A 25-year-old video patent just expired, ending a legal headache for Linux
items.title_zh: 25 岁的视频专利到期，结束 Linux 的法律麻烦
items.summary_en: A long-standing Brazilian patent related to video technology has expired, removing a legal hurdle for Linux-based video playback and distribution. The expiry could simplify patent risk calculations for distributions and boost compatibility for multimedia stacks.
items.summary_zh: 一项与视频技术相关的巴西专利已于今日到期，消除了 Linux 相关的法律障碍。到期可能简化发行版在多媒体编解码方面的专利风险评估，并提升兼容性与部署便利性。

items.title_en: Supersonic Trebuchet [video]
items.title_zh: 超音速投石机（视频）
items.summary_en: An engineering-focused video documents a supersonic trebuchet project, highlighting the physics of high-velocity launching and real-world design challenges. It covers mechanism design, material limits, and safety considerations during testing.
items.summary_zh: 这是一段聚焦工程的视频，记录了一个超音速投石机项目，突出高速度发射的物理原理与实际设计挑战。视频介绍了机构设计、材料极限，以及在测试中需要考虑的安全因素。

items.title_en: Teaching my kid to code with a modern MUD
items.title_zh: 用现代 MUD 教孩子编程
items.summary_en: A parent's approach to teaching coding through a modern MUD, blending storytelling with hands-on programming tasks. It demonstrates how interactive game worlds can make programming concepts tangible for kids.
items.summary_zh: 以现代 MUD 为载体教学编程的家长实践，结合叙事与动手任务，展示互动游戏世界如何让孩子更好地理解编程与系统思维。

items.title_en: Activation Energy is a good model for a lot of things
items.title_zh: 激活能量：适用于多领域的良好模型
items.summary_en: Activation energy is proposed as a useful modeling metaphor beyond chemistry, applied to technology adoption, learning dynamics, and system bottlenecks. The piece argues that barrier-like models can explain when and why transitions happen, offering a simple lens for complex processes.
items.summary_zh: 文章提出激活能量作为化学之外的有用建模隐喻，适用于技术采用、学习动力学以及系统瓶颈等场景。作者认为将转变看作跨越能垒的过程，可以用简单的模型解释何时、为何会发生转换，从而为复杂现象提供直观的分析框架。

items.title_en: A decades-old bug in Knuth's long division (TAOCP Vol II, Algorithm 4.3.1D)
items.title_zh: Knuth 长除法中的几十年前的漏洞（TAOCP 第 II 卷，算法 4.3.1D）
items.summary_en: A decades-old bug in Knuth's long division algorithm (TAOCP Vol II, Algorithm 4.3.1D) has been highlighted, illustrating subtle pitfalls in numeric methods and the risk of relying on classical references without validation. The post underscores the importance of peer review and continuing scrutiny of foundational algorithms.
items.summary_zh: 在 Knuth 的《TAOCP》第二卷算法 4.3.1D 的长除法实现中，长期存在的一个 bug 被揭示，揭示了数值方法中的微妙陷阱以及仅凭经典教材可能带来的风险。该文章强调对基础算法的同行评审和持续审视的重要性。

items.title_en: Rings forged from meteorites may have been fashionable among ancient Greek elite
items.title_zh: 陨石戒指：古希腊贵族的时尚饰品
items.summary_en: Researchers analyzed meteorite-derived iron rings and found they were fashionable among ancient Greek elites, possibly due to mythic associations and rarity. The finding sheds light on metallurgy, trade networks, and cultural value placed on exotic materials in antiquity.
items.summary_zh: 研究者对陨石铁戒指进行分析，发现陨铁戒指在古希腊贵族中颇受欢迎，或与神话崇拜和材料稀缺性有关。此项发现揭示了古代冶金、贸易网络及对稀有材料的文化价值观。

items.title_en: Taffy: A flexible, high-performance, cross-platform UI layout library
items.title_zh: Taffy：一个灵活高性能的跨平台 UI 布局库
items.summary_en: Taffy is a fast, flexible cross-platform UI layout library from DioxusLabs, designed to deliver deterministic layouts across desktop, mobile, and embedded targets. Built with performance in mind, it aims to rival existing layout engines and improve the responsiveness of UI toolchains in Rust ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: Taffy 是 DioxusLabs 推出的一个快速、灵活的跨平台 UI 布局库，旨在在桌面、移动和嵌入式设备上提供确定性的布局。以高性能为目标，它意在与现有布局引擎竞争，提升 Rust 生态中的 UI 构建链的响应速度。

items.title_en: CUDA Shared Memory Swizzling
items.title_zh: CUDA 共享内存换位
items.summary_en: A technical explainer on swizzling in CUDA shared memory to improve coalesced accesses and reduce bank conflicts on GPUs.
items.summary_zh: 这是关于在 CUDA 共享内存中采用换位（swizzling）技术以优化内存访问聚合、降低银行冲突的技术解读。文中给出何时、如何应用换位的要点，并附有示例与性能要点。

items.title_en: How a giant battery is transforming a town centre in Cannington, Ontario
items.title_zh: 巨型电池如何改变安大略省坎宁顿镇中心
items.summary_en: A large-scale energy storage installation is reshaping the town center in Cannington, boosting grid stability, local resilience, and potential economic development through energy storage.
items.summary_zh: 一座大型储能装置正在提升坎宁顿镇中心的电网稳定性与韧性，并可能推动当地经济发展。该项目展示了储能在小城镇能源安全中的作用。

items.title_en: Show HN: Nikon F100 Film Camera Repair Notes
items.title_zh: Show HN：Nikon F100 胶片相机修理笔记
items.summary_en: An open-source collection of repair notes for the Nikon F100 film camera, detailing common faults and fixes with diagrams and parts sources. It helps hobbyists and DIY technicians extend the life of analog gear.
items.summary_zh: 关于尼康 F100 胶片相机的修理笔记的开源合集，整理了常见故障的排查方法、部件清单和维修技巧，附带示意图与配件来源。帮助爱好者和 DIY 技术人员延长这类模拟设备的使用寿命。

items.title_en: A recipe for drone racing with reinforcement learning
items.title_zh: 用强化学习进行无人机竞速的配方
items.summary_en: An actionable guide detailing how to apply RL to drone racing, covering environment setup, state representations, reward design, and training regimes. It demonstrates pushing control systems to the limit, discusses sim-to-real transfer challenges, and offers practical tips for researchers and hobbyists.
items.summary_zh: 给出一个将强化学习应用于无人机赛道的可操作指南，涵盖环境搭建、状态表示、奖励设计以及训练方案。展示了将控制系统推向极限的思路，同时讨论仿真到现实的迁移挑战，并提供给研究者和爱好者的实际建议。

items.title_en: Looking for Missed Alarm Bugs in a Formal Verification Tool
items.title_zh: 在形式化验证工具中寻找被遗漏的报警缺陷
items.summary_en: An analysis of missed alarms in a formal verification tool highlights that even rigorous tooling can miss edge cases. The piece emphasizes the importance of robust property checks, test coverage, and continuous tooling improvement to maintain correctness in critical systems.
items.summary_zh: 对某个形式化验证工具中遗漏的警报进行分析，表明即便是严格的验证工具也会错过边界情况。强调对属性检查的鲁棒性、测试覆盖率以及持续的工具改进对于关键系统的正确性至关重要。

items.title_en: Turning molecules into reliable electronic devices
items.title_zh: 把分子变成可靠的电子设备
items.summary_en: MIT reports progress in using individual molecules to function as electronic components, including diodes or wires, with improved reliability and manufacturability. Advances could lead to ultra-dense, energy-efficient electronics and novel computing paradigms, though manufacturing challenges remain.
items.summary_zh: 麻省理工学院报道了将单分子用于电子元件（如二极管与导线）的进展，以及提高可靠性与可制造性。此类突破可能带来极高密度、低功耗的电子设备和新型计算范式，但在大规模制造方面还存在挑战。
